decisions.reason: An online customer portal costs little to maintain once built and its value to customer relationships is still unfolding, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 is a strong positive signal that resolves uncertainty in favour of further commitment rather than abandonment.
The quarter-pallet display was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, so its prospects are still uncertain while the cost of keeping it in a display portfolio is low.
Small counter displays are a standard, low-cost line for a display maker, and one year is too early to judge its value, so the option stays open.

The large freestanding display is still too new for its results to show its value and costs little to keep, though the firm's quick withdrawal of Product A suggests it may prune its many display options.
